title: LangChain Repository
summary: LangChain is a framework for developing applications powered by large language models (LLMs). It simplifies the process of building complex LLM workflows by providing modular components for interacting with LLMs, managing data, orchestrating agents, and evaluating performance. Developers can use LangChain to create sophisticated applications like chatbots, question-answering systems, and autonomous agents.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User/Developer
nodes.description: Interacts with the LangChain framework to build, run, and evaluate LLM-powered applications.

nodes.label: Core Utilities
nodes.title: LangChain Core Utilities
nodes.description: Provides foundational utilities for API lifecycle management, security, callback handling, chat history, data serialization, and system information, forming the base for the LangChain ecosystem.

nodes.label: Language Models & Prompts
nodes.title: Language Models & Prompts
nodes.description: Offers interfaces for interacting with LLMs, managing prompts, handling messages, generating embeddings, and integrating with third-party LLM providers.

nodes.label: Agents & Chains
nodes.title: Agents and Chains Module
nodes.description: Provides core components for building intelligent agents and orchestrating complex workflows (chains) using language models, tools, memory, and runnables.

nodes.label: Data & Retrieval
nodes.title: Data and Retrieval Module
nodes.description: Offers functionalities for loading, splitting, indexing, and retrieving documents from various sources, along with managing vector stores and implementing diverse retrieval strategies.

nodes.label: Evaluation & Testing
nodes.title: LLM Evaluation and Testing
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for evaluating the performance of language models and agents, including various evaluation chains, evaluators, configuration runners, and tracing tools.

groups.label: Core Building Blocks
groups.title: Core Building Blocks
groups.description: Fundamental components for interacting with language models, managing prompts, and providing essential utilities for the framework.

groups.label: Application Orchestration
groups.title: Application Orchestration
groups.description: Modules dedicated to constructing and managing complex LLM-powered applications, including agents and sequential chains of operations.

groups.label: Data Management & Quality
groups.title: Data Management & Quality
groups.description: Components for handling data ingestion, storage, retrieval, and ensuring the quality and performance of LLM applications through evaluation and testing.
